cds.title: Kansas State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: CDS C1 residency split (in-state 7,088 / out-of-state 7,102 / international 1,401 applicants). International admit rate computed 463/1,401 = 33.0%, with 43 enrolled, much lower than the overall 87.5%, so international applicants should not assume near-certain admission. Undergrad enrollment and intl count are the B2 'Total Undergraduates' column (16,555; nonresident 253). No early decision or early action; no waitlist; no application closing date; priority date December 1. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column (reported by 86.5% of students).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT/ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'; scores are also used for advising and placement.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year rates (the CDS ticks '2026-27 costs not available yet, expected 7/23/2026', so these are treated as 2025-26 rates; the 'Nonresident' tuition line is used for international students). H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; the CDS leaves the recipient count and dollar amounts blank.
